messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — onboarding smoke for orion-13b is failing the config lint and gate checks. Landing page: weights pointed at gs://redwood-models/orion-13b/weights.tar.gz but the validator is expecting weight_uri with s3:// prefix. Also seeing tokenizer vocab mismatch vs manifest :/
Chris: Can you paste the exact lint output? I can patch a fix if it's just default fields missing.
Maya: paste from gate:
```
CONFIG_GATE ERROR: missing field 'context_size' (required)
CONFIG_GATE WARN: tokenizer.vocab_file does not match manifest 'vocab.json' checksum
ASSET_RESOLVE ERROR: weight_uri scheme unsupported: gs://... (supported: s3://, http[s]://)
```
Oliver: FYI our serving runtime normalizes weight_uri -> s3:// internally, but the gate only accepts canonical s3/http on ingest. We should avoid gs:// in manifests.
Sam: Is the vocab actually different or just path? sometimes people upload a new vocab to GCS but forget to update manifest checksum.
Maya: I checked tarball contents quickly — there is a vocab.json inside weights.tar.gz and a separate manifest asset pointing to https://assets.redwood.ai/models/orion-13b/vocab.json (different sha256).
Chris: ok easy path: two options — (A) update manifest to reference internal asset URL + correct checksum, or (B) re-publish weights tar with the manifest's vocab. Which does product prefer?
Maya: Product prefers stable asset host (https). so we should update weight_uri to s3:// for gate, and update manifest checksum to match external vocab.
Oliver: I can add a quick sanitizer in the ingest pipeline that rejects gs:// and returns a more actionable error, but we should fix this model manifest first.
GateBot: CONFIG_GATE: RUNNING checks for thread 2799991234...
GateBot: CONFIG_GATE: FAIL — missing 'context_size'; SUGGESTED DEFAULT: "2048".
Chris: I'll open a tiny PR to patch the manifest: set weight_uri->s3://rwd-models/orion-13b/weights.tar.gz, add context_size: 2048, and update tokenizer.vocab_file checksum to match https://assets.redwood.ai/models/orion-13b/vocab.json.
Maya: Thanks — also add tokenizer.pad_id explicitly (some runtime paths assume 0). Current manifest lacks pad_id.
Chris: Good catch. I'll set pad_id: 0 and unk_id: 3 per their vocab.
Sam: Once PR is up ping me and I'll re-run the ingest gate locally.
Maya: pinging @Chris when PR is ready — I'll run a smoke after gate passes. :white_check_mark:
Chris: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/compare/PR-1234 — includes three small edits, lint passes locally.
GateBot: GATE CHECK: re-run for PR-1234...
GateBot: CONFIG_GATE: PASS. ASSET_RESOLVE: PASS.
Sam: Re-ran ingest smoke — model onboarded to staging successfully. quick perf smoke looks fine. :thumbsup:
Maya: Awesome. Can someone add a one-liner to the onboarding checklist reminding folks to avoid gs:// in manifests? Low-friction fix.
Oliver: Will add a checklist bullet and a brief validator message for the next deploy.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Closing the loop here — will schedule a short doc blurb in docs/ when checklist item is merged.
